scope: Every row of the standalone /site/ 13-row evidence review (research/candidates.json) re-opened on this session's own clock at the seller's own official URL, plus an independent gold-price reading. The canonical 71-row root dataset was NOT touched: data/rings.json, data/flagged.json, data/gold-price.json, data/checks/**, scripts/build.mjs, scripts/verify.mjs, the generated root *.html and README.md are owned by the concurrent eleventh-pass sessions (T47/T48/T49).
method: Bash egress in this sandbox is allowlist-only, so reads used the session page-fetch channel, as in COORDINATION.md §17 and §21. Shopify sellers were read through their own product JSON endpoint (officialProductUrl + '.js'), which is the seller's own feed for the same product; Brilliant Earth and Blue Nile were read on the product page itself. Nothing was taken from a search snippet, an aggregator, a screenshot or memory.
